headword: {新卒採用|しんそつさいよう}
gloss: new graduate hiring; recruitment of fresh graduates

definitions.gloss: hiring of new graduates; fresh graduate recruitment
definitions.explanation: The Japanese practice of companies hiring university or high school graduates all at once in spring, typically for April entry. A defining feature of traditional Japanese employment culture, contrasting with 中途採用 (mid-career hiring).

examples.english: In new graduate hiring, the practice of batch-hiring new employees in April is standard.

notes:
USAGE:
New graduate hiring (新卒採用) is a cornerstone of traditional Japanese employment culture. Companies recruit graduating students through a structured process (就職活動, or 就活) typically beginning in their final year. New hires all start on April 1st.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新卒採用|しんそつさいよう}{枠|わく}: new graduate recruitment quota
- {新卒採用|しんそつさいよう}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: new graduate job-seeking activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中途採用|ちゅうとさいよう}→中途採用：17725_chuutosaiyou⟧: mid-career hiring (of experienced workers, year-round)
- ⟦{新卒|しんそつ}→新卒：12871_shinsotsu⟧: new graduate (abbreviation)
